text:
maria: Hey all — I pushed follow-up commits to the PR https://git.redux/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412. I addressed the review comments and fixed the flaky test. PTAL when you have a moment. Summary:
- Reworked the KV cache eviction defensive checks (added explicit bounds check)
- Fixed race in `batcher.go` by using `sync.Cond` instead of a sleep-based retry
- Updated unit test to mock time and added an integration-style test that runs in CI
- Added a short note in CHANGELOG about behavior change

alex: Thanks — quick skim looks good. One tiny nit: can we rename `TestBatcherRace` -> `TestBatcher_RaceCondition` to follow our test naming? Also, the mock time helper is exported, can we move it under `testutil` package?
maria: Good catches — renamed the test and moved the helper under `testutil`. Also added a comment for the eviction bounds. Pushed another commit.
ci-bot: Build started for infra PR #412 (sha: c3f2a7d). Running unit & integration jobs.
jordan: I reviewed the latest commit, the `sync.Cond` change makes sense. Only question: do we need a migration note for customers using Dedicated? (probably not but wanted to check)
maria: For Dedicated customers, behavior is functionally the same (we tightened a defensive check). Added a one-liner in the ops notes and flagged it for release notes if ops wants to expand.
sam: CI is flaky today — if the integration test is slow it might time out in the 10m runner. Can you run the integration job locally with `make integration` and push a separate artifact?
maria: Yep running locally now. Command I used: `make integration TESTARGS="-run TestBatcher_RaceCondition -timeout 15m"` — passed locally. Pushing the CI re-run.
ci-bot: Job infra/unit passed. infra/integration (rerun) started.
lee: PTAL from me tomorrow morning — but if CI goes green and there's an approve, can we merge during the 2pm merge window? I won't be around at 5pm to rollback if anything odd happens.
jordan: Approved. :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: infra/integration passed. All checks green.
maria: Thanks everyone — merging now. Command: `git merge --no-ff c3f2a7d && git push origin main`. Will monitor logs for 30m and open a rollback if anything noisy. :shipit:
ale x: (typo in username fixed)
